content:
The hexagonal cut has side length \(2\sqrt{2}\), so its area is
\[
\frac{3\sqrt3}{2}(2\sqrt2)^2=12\sqrt3.
\]
Total surface area of both pieces:
\[
96+2(12\sqrt3)=96+24\sqrt3.
\]
Each piece has half this surface area:
\[
48+12\sqrt3 \approx 68.78.
\]
Rounded to the nearest square centimeter:
\[
\boxed{69}
\]
